tasks.title: Warm-up: breath, hum, lip trills
tasks.instructions: Breathe in for 4, out on "sss" for 8, four times. Hum low to high three times. Finish with 30 seconds of lip trills.

tasks.title: Follow-up reps: ladder to "so what"
tasks.instructions: For each guest line, write the follow-up that takes the guest one level deeper (what, then why, then so what).
prompts: We decided to open-source the evaluation suite, even though it was a competitive advantage.
The pilot with the bank went well, but the compliance review took longer than the build.

tasks.title: Falling-intonation drill
tasks.instructions: Read each claim and let your pitch fall at the end, as a statement, not a question.
prompts: 1. Multi-turn attacks succeed where single prompts fail.
2. Evaluation must follow the whole conversation.
3. The risk compounds with every turn.

tasks.title: Weekly probe: 2-minute unscripted answer
tasks.instructions: About two minutes, no notes: what would you tell a bank board about conversational AI risk?

carried.title: Contrastive-stress drill
carried.instructions: Read each sentence twice, stressing a different word each time: "I said she should present the results." Then: "I said SHE should present the results."
